correctness.rationale: The inverse of the read profile is exactly an Euler trail on the order-two binary de Bruijn graph. Conservation expresses e,g,c in terms of b,d,f and endpoint divergence. Every admissible nonloop support is weakly connected because all nonloop cycles share vertices 01 and 10; detached 00/11 loops are excluded explicitly. The four orbit-class rational sums are exhaustive/disjoint, and their algebra yields the stated numerator. The pole analysis establishes exact least period twelve and the leading constant \(13/288\). Direct word/flow/Euler-witness verification from VERIFY.py agrees with the infinite proof through all tested cases.

originality.rationale: The inspected exact cyclic ordered-threegram count covers only balanced profiles, and the linear three-window Hamming-weight count is a coarser projected invariant. Kiah et al. provide a general quasipolynomial degree/period theorem but not this explicit all-length binary length-three formula; Jacquet et al. analyze first-order types; Yehezkeally et al. asymptotic multi-strand rates. Targeted literature and scientific-database comparisons yielded no stronger exact formula. Unindexed equivalent priority remains a stated risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed exact enumeration of binary order-two linear Markov types could already imply the result.

value.rationale: A complete ordered triple-read multiset is a naturally motivated, experimentally meaningful idealized sequencing observable. The exact count equals optimal zero-error code size for every finite word length. The proof resolves nontrivial endpoint-divergent and weak-connectivity corrections and gives an exact period-twelve degree-four law instead of only asymptotic rate/degree, so it is neither an arbitrary slice nor routine restatement.
